locations.label: Cargo Exo Suits
locations.description: The creator places the Exo station in Cargo. Collect an Exo Suit and open the Armory, Cargo Deck, Lift, Moon Pool, Hangar, Bio Lab and Gun Deck routes needed below. Identify upgrade stations and the Armory Teleport Grenade wallbuy. Ordinary bomb-defusal rounds are map objectives, separate from the tablet sequence. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Chompy generator room
locations.description: Activate Chompy in Cargo Deck. As its wall door opens, throw a Teleport Grenade into the small room before the door closes. Once inside, activate the generator; the room soon returns you to the deck. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Weapon / Grenade Disposal
locations.description: The generator activates Weapon Disposal and the special Grenade Disposal puzzle in the Armory. Confirm their lights/power before spending weapons or beginning the icon sequence. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Four-tablet vault
locations.description: Take the tablet from the right-hand slot and deposit it at the Gun Deck vault door. If it will not accept the tablet, wait for Oz’s dialogue to finish and interact again. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Fishing rod
locations.description: Feed Weapon Disposal distinct weapons; repeating a weapon already submitted does not advance its item payout. Its early rewards are the bottle, reel, line and hook. Install each rod part on the Gun Deck rod immediately before claiming another: a new part replaces an uninstalled held part. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Bio Lab teleporter
locations.description: Kill teleporting zombies or dogs and collect their telefrag pieces promptly; floor drops expire. Carry one piece at a time and install it at the inactive Bio Lab teleporter. After 20 installed pieces the teleporter is usable. Their availability increases later in the match; wait for the relevant enemies instead of assuming every kill can drop one. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Shark cage controls
locations.description: Install the lever in the Moon Pool electrical box beside the printer. Kill zombies around the three floor grates until their blood attracts the swimming shark. When it passes beneath the central opening, pay the box’s 1,000-credit activation and jump onto the cage to descend. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Captain DJ locker
locations.description: Inspect Captain DJ’s locker near Hangar Exo Medic to hear the eye-scanner clue. After this, a pair of treasure drones can spawn over later rounds. Shoot the EMPTY drone to recover its lever; a normal filled loot drone does not provide this quest item. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
